note: GTA VI income source predictions. All figures are predicted/reported unless marked confirmed. Payout figures are post-launch estimates based on GTA Online precedent and economic modelling. Source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis.

income_predictions.name: Vice City Jewellery Store Heist
income_predictions.basis: Trailer 2 clearly shows a jewellery store heist sequence: Lucia smashing display cases, jewellery extraction, getaway. Multi-stage approach with preparation visible. Strong structural parallel to GTA Online's Casino Heist as a high-value urban score.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI trailer frame analysis — T2

income_predictions.name: Vice City Bank Robbery
income_predictions.trailer_evidence: T1 — 0:08, T2 — 0:52, EL — 9:00 Raul Bautista / highway chase
income_predictions.basis: Trailer 1 shows Lucia in arrest/prison context with bank robbery implied backstory. Trailer 2 shows armed robbery sequence with Jason and Lucia in coordinated roles. The Extended Look's second mission chapter has Raul Bautista recruiting the pair into a bank-robbery crew, then a freeway chase — the job is now a named story beat, not just implied.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI trailer frame analysis

income_predictions.name: Leonida Smuggling Operations
income_predictions.basis: Trailer 2 shows airboat smuggling runs, aircraft drops, and organised criminal logistics in Leonida's rural waterways. Region-specific business type distinct from Vice City operations. Structural parallel to GTA Online's Cayo Perico as a location-locked high-yield activity.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI trailer analysis + multi-region economic model

income_predictions.name: Vice City Nightclub & Entertainment
income_predictions.basis: Trailer 2 shows club and strip club interiors in Vice City, consistent with GTA Online's Nightclub passive income model. Urban entertainment business fits Vice City's identity. Region-specific businesses confirmed by Trailer 2 multi-region diagram annotations.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI trailer analysis + region-specific business prediction (pred-vi-region-specific-businesses)

income_predictions.name: Leonida Agricultural & Rural Operations
income_predictions.basis: Grassrivers region in Trailer 2 shows farm operations and rural criminal activity. The multi-region prediction model confirms region-specific business types — agricultural and smuggling operations in Leonida vs urban entertainment in Vice City. Structural parallel to GTA Online's Gunrunning Bunker as a passive supply-chain business.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI trailer analysis + pred-vi-region-specific-businesses

income_predictions.name: GTA VI Online Passive Income Stack
income_predictions.basis: GTA Online's passive stack grew from $0 in 2013 to $1.24M/hr by 2022. GTA VI Online inherits the same MMT sovereign model at structurally higher yield floor. A full passive stack (VC nightclub + Leonida operations + mobile persistence) is predicted to ceiling higher than GTA Online's current maximum.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — pred-vi-launch-top-yield

income_predictions.name: Mobile-Linked Business Management
income_predictions.basis: Take-Two's live-service strategy and the multi-region model both point to mobile companion app integration. iFruit app precedent (GTA Online) established the pattern. Mobile persistence means businesses run between sessions — directly extending the passive income model with asynchronous management.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — pred-vi-mobile-persistence

prediction_range.high: Active management affecting business state and yield

income_predictions.name: Weekly Bonus Events & Rotations
income_predictions.basis: GTA Online has run weekly bonus events every Thursday since 2017 without interruption. Take-Two earnings reports consistently cite live events as primary monetisation drivers. The cadence is structural — not optional. GTA VI Online will replicate this model from Day 1 or within the first month.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — pred-vi-weekly-event-cadence

prediction_range.high: Weekly from Day 1 (continuation of GTA Online model)

income_predictions.name: Cross-Territory Heist (Cayo Equivalent)
income_predictions.basis: Every GTA Online era has a marquee solo-capable heist that defines the income ceiling. Cayo Perico (2020) set the template: island location, solo capable, $2M+ per run. GTA VI's multi-region structure creates a natural cross-region equivalent — a high-stakes operation spanning Vice City and Leonida that becomes the S-tier income benchmark.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model Analysis — franchise heist cadence pattern

income_predictions.name: GTA VI Online Contact Missions
income_predictions.basis: Contact missions are the foundational activity layer of every GTA Online title — introduced at launch and expanded with every DLC. GTA VI Online will launch with a set of contact missions across both territories, given by established contacts (Lucia/Jason's criminal network). Per-run payout will be calibrated above GTA Online's 2013 baseline ($15-30K) given structural yield inflation.
income_predictions.source: GTAVI.AI Economic Model — franchise mission cadence precedent

income_predictions.name: Leonida Hunting and Trapping
income_predictions.trailer_evidence: EL — hunting / wildlife study in Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga
income_predictions.basis: Hunting is confirmed as a playable activity in the Extended Look (alongside fishing, kayaking, scuba). IGN adds that animals can be studied and new species are tracked. Payouts are still modelled from RDR2 hunting (RDR$0.25–$9.00 per animal × GTA income inflation). Zero-risk ambient income — lower ceiling than missions, always available in Grassrivers / Mount Kalaga.
income_predictions.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN preview · RDR2 hunting.json payout model

income_predictions.name: Bail Bond and Bounty Contracts
income_predictions.basis: RDR Online's Bounty Hunter role paid RDR$50–$300 per bounty, with legendary bounties at $100–$300. Scaling to GTA VI income levels and the confirmed bail bond activity seen in trailers (Lucia's arrest context), this maps to a contract-per-mission income source. Closer to GTA Online Headhunter/Dispatch missions in structure — short, repeatable, skill-dependent.
income_predictions.source: RDR Online Bounty Hunter role + GTA VI trailer context (Lucia arrest backstory)

income_predictions.name: Resource Trading (Trader Role Analogue)
income_predictions.basis: RDR Online's Trader role (Butcher's Table) introduced the supply→process→sell cycle that became GTA Online's Bunker and MC business template. RDR Trader paid RDR$625 per full local delivery on a ~2hr cycle. Scaling by franchise income inflation and adjusting for GTA VI's higher cost ceiling, this maps to a mid-tier passive business. Port Gellhorn's dock infrastructure in Trailer 2 suggests a shipping/trading operation hub.
income_predictions.source: RDR Online Trader role income model + GTA VI location analysis

income_predictions.name: Collectible Circuit (Collector Role Analogue)
income_predictions.basis: RDR Online's Collector role turned world exploration into income — 9 sets worth ~$400 each. GTA Online had collectibles (hidden packages, signal jammers) but none generated income. The dual-territory GTA VI world — Vice City urban grid + Leonida wilderness — has the geographic complexity and variety to support a collector economy for the first time in the franchise. Lowest confidence income card in this set; no direct community source confirmation.
income_predictions.source: RDR Online Collector role + GTAVI.AI economic model

income_predictions.name: Wildlife Research (Naturalist Role Analogue)
income_predictions.basis: RDR Online's Naturalist role (Harriet Davenport) paid RDR$10–$25 per animal sample and RDR$100 for legendary specimens. The Leonida setting — with confirmed Everglades-analogue wildlife (alligators, exotic birds, big cats) from trailer analysis — has stronger geographic justification for a wildlife economy than any previous GTA title. If GTA VI has hunting, a research/sampling layer is the natural complement, similar to how the Naturalist extended the Trader's hunting economy.

prediction_range.high: GTA$250,000/hr for dedicated naturalists in Leonida wilderness

income_predictions.source: RDR Online Naturalist role + Leonida world geography analysis

income_predictions.name: Classic Car Collection (Wyman Commissions)
income_predictions.basis: Confirmed via Ultimate Edition description: exclusive commission missions for a character named Wyman involving restoring and delivering abandoned vehicles. Structural parallel to GTA Online Auto Shop (Union Depository loop) — vehicle sourcing + delivery format with story integration. Ultimate Edition exclusive content.
income_predictions.source: Rockstar Newswire Ultimate Edition announcement (Jun 25, 2026)

income_predictions.name: PTT Youngin$ Compound Raids
income_predictions.basis: Confirmed via Ultimate Edition: exclusive PTT Youngin$ compound lets players raid a Southside gang compound and escape with special items and contraband. Maps to a repeatable contraband-run format. Ultimate Edition exclusive, likely single-run per session with cooldown.
income_predictions.source: Rockstar Newswire Ultimate Edition announcement (Jun 25, 2026)

income_predictions.name: Ultimate Edition Exclusive Vehicle Fleet
income_predictions.basis: Ultimate Edition confirms 6 exclusive vehicles: '95 Grotti Cheetah, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy + garage, Shitzu Squalo speedboat, Dinka Enduro, Crest Kayak, Ganado Retro Build. High-value sports cars (Cheetah tier) are historically the most profitable vehicle export targets in GTA Online. The Squalo speedboat with explosives crate suggests a water-based smuggling run.
income_predictions.source: Rockstar Newswire Ultimate Edition announcement (Jun 25, 2026)

income_predictions.name: WAINK Vehicle Theft & Resale Circuit
income_predictions.trailer_evidence: Extended Look — WAINK app shown scanning vehicles
income_predictions.basis: WAINK app confirmed in Extended Look: scans parked vehicles for value, lock status, alarm, and tracker. Security tiers require specific tools (Slim Jim / key cloner). High-value tracked vehicles carry risk but higher payouts. Pay n' Spray and specialty car fences confirmed as sale destinations. Mirrors and expands GTA Online's Import/Export vehicle warehouse model with a pre-theft information layer.
income_predictions.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN Rob Nelson preview (Aug 27, 2026)

prediction_range.high: GTA$900,000/hr (high-value tracked, optimal route + Pay n' Spray)

income_predictions.name: Street-Level Store Robberies
income_predictions.trailer_evidence: EL — gas station and waffle restaurant robberies
income_predictions.basis: Extended Look shows Jason and Lucia robbing a gas station and a waffle restaurant with split roles. IGN confirms a speed-vs-profit tradeoff (blow the safe vs crack the combination) and police staging at the front door. Repeatable ambient income below heist scale — the everyday cash loop that can feed story money-gates.
income_predictions.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN Rockstar North preview (Aug 27, 2026)

income_predictions.name: Specialised Fences — Goods and Vehicles
income_predictions.trailer_evidence: EL / IGN — Pay n' Spray plus separate valuables and vehicle fences
income_predictions.predicted_payout_per_run: Haircut on stolen goods — 40–70% of scanned value
income_predictions.basis: IGN: stolen items go to specialised fences — different contacts for valuables vs vehicles. Pay n' Spray is a confirmed sale / launder destination for stolen cars. Damage reduces sale value. This is the conversion layer between WAINK theft / store robberies and spendable GTA$.
income_predictions.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look + IGN Rockstar North preview (Aug 27, 2026)

income_predictions.name: Venture Apartments Raid
income_predictions.basis: Extended Look Mission 1 is a named story beat at Venture Apartments in Rockridge: a San4San drug-lab contact job that collapses into a Méndez-led raid. Confirmed as campaign structure, not a repeatable Online loop. Payout is story-gated; six-star wanted and Criminal Profile fire during the escape.
income_predictions.source: GTA VI: An Extended Look (Aug 27, 2026)

prediction_range.low: Story mission — no repeatable take published
prediction_range.high: Story mission — no repeatable take published

income_predictions.name: Celebrity Security / Gala Contracts
income_predictions.trailer_evidence: EL — Jason and Lucia run security at a corporate gala that turns hostage
income_predictions.basis: Extended Look's third mission chapter is a high-end event: Jason and Lucia on a celebrity security detail that collapses into a Die Hard-style hostage sequence. Distinct from street robberies and heists — a contact-mission tier that pays for presence and combat, not loot extraction. Analogous to GTA Online VIP / security work.
